invariants: present means the workflow file exists on main right now
registry-only means GitHub still lists a registration whose file no longer exists
every file under .github/workflows must appear exactly once
a workflow with a schedule or a push/pull_request trigger is never left on the retire list

workflows.name: decision-os-ci
workflows.responsibility: Ready/main gate: partitions, contracts and the merge-eligible receipt
workflows.exit: retained in the current GitHub deployment with full CI; any platform replacement must independently verify equivalent native events, protections and reviewable receipts

workflows.name: decision-os-research-runtime
workflows.responsibility: Current hosted receiver for research, hosted handoff, odds and decision preparation through the existing store and single-writer/CAS contract
workflows.consumers: the single remote writer; 54 test modules reference research_runtime
workflows.exit: retained in the current deployment until an authorized replacement proves the same write, exact readback and unknown-write reconciliation contract; eligible read operations already have a local console
workflows.note: 39 of the last 51 dispatches were read-only jobs; those reads do not need a runner

workflows.name: decision-os-store-runtime
workflows.responsibility: Current execution adapter for records backup, integrity and health; independent recovery is required, execution beside the store is not a permanent constraint
workflows.exit: retained until a replacement proves authority, integrity, independent recovery and rollback; a local mirror or reader cache alone does not establish a backup

workflows.name: decision-os-daily-market
workflows.responsibility: Suspended legacy full-master/six-stock daily deployment; preserve historical cycle, market and discovery readers while narrowing production by actual consumer needs
workflows.exit: code retained, not active production: daily-runtime-version.json enabled=false revokes business admission; resume requires an explicit accepted scope and unknown-effect reconciliation; history must remain readable before any code retirement
workflows.note: no native schedule; the external service job must be disabled and read back separately. The deployment switch does not certify that job is off. clock-probe remains metadata-only and cannot admit business execution

workflows.name: decision-os-announcement-discovery
workflows.responsibility: Bounded public announcement-directory metadata capture into authorized records
workflows.exit: retained for the current daily capture mandate; it is the only present file with a native schedule. The separate daily-market deployment is suspended; replacement of announcements still needs equivalent scope, timing, rights and consumer adoption

workflows.name: decision-os-market-custody
workflows.responsibility: Market custody verification and comparison receipts
workflows.exit: not retired: custody checks need the same writer and token boundary as the store

workflows.name: decision-os-relay-source-runtime
workflows.responsibility: Relay plan and authorized capture of source rows into records
workflows.exit: not retired: capture writes records and holds the supplier key

workflows.name: decision-os-news-intake
workflows.responsibility: Pinned NewsNow container or Relay capture of one bounded news window
workflows.exit: not retired: it is the only executable intake for the news desk

workflows.name: decision-os-news-rolling
workflows.responsibility: Rolling news desk windows and the latest-desk discovery mode
workflows.exit: not retired: it is the current consumer of retained news slices

workflows.name: decision-os-news-custody
workflows.responsibility: News custody receipts and origin recovery
workflows.exit: not retired: origin recovery is a custody duty, not a UI duty

workflows.name: decision-os-news-handoff
workflows.responsibility: Deliver one completed native capture or reconcile its original source_run without writing
workflows.exit: retire only after the news desk no longer needs a capture-to-delivery bridge; that needs a named replacement consumer first

workflows.name: decision-os-market-source-check
workflows.responsibility: Read-only source diagnostics: availability, session coverage, history, factor audit, member recovery
workflows.consumers: docs/architecture/market-source-check.md, ashare-availability, ashare-session-coverage, ashare-factor-reconciliation; 14 test modules
workflows.exit: not retired: the diagnostics stay; only the place they run moves, and the GitHub entry stays as a fallback
workflows.note: every selection is a bounded read that never exports supplier rows, so it is a candidate for the local read console

workflows.name: decision-os-relay-capabilities
workflows.responsibility: Service metadata probe that answers which Relay capabilities exist, not business data
workflows.exit: not retired: it is the only producer of capability evidence; it moves local only where the supplier key is also available offline
workflows.note: needs TUSHARE_PROXY_API_KEY; without the secret locally it stays a runner-only read

workflows.name: decision-os-ashare-data
workflows.responsibility: Finite A-share collection: status read, sync and repair writes
workflows.exit: status is a read and can move local; sync and repair keep the writer. The dated one-off checks are already gone from the menu
workflows.note: the five dated operations (ftshare-check 20261018, check-kernel 20261019, calendar 20261018, adopt-kernel, check-continue) left the dispatch menu on 2026-10-23 because docs/sources/ftshare-daily.md closes them ('verified, not to be reopened'); their CLIs stay so the historical receipts remain readable

workflows.name: decision-os-rss-intake
workflows.responsibility: Explicit fixed RSS capture or exact stored read
workflows.exit: retire new capture only after a mature replacement proves the same feed scope, timing, rights and failure semantics with actual consumer adoption and rollback; historical RSS references and failure receipts remain readable
workflows.note: last run 2026-10-16: no new duty since, but zero recent use is not the same as no consumer
